title: The carry goes in the back
prompt: Stage 2-3, level 5. Your frontline is set. Your 2-star ranged carry with an item is on the bench after you combined a component. Put it where it will shoot the longest before anyone reaches it.
explanation:
Ranged units attack from four hexes away, so a carry on the back row starts shooting immediately while every enemy melee unit has to walk through your frontline first. Row 0 is where the fight happens; row 3 is where damage is dealt safely. Any back-row hex that is not a corner is fine at this stage: the corners are fine too against most boards, but keep the habit of the centre-back until you scout a reason to move.

The frontline stays together in the middle so enemies bump into it before they find the carry.
principle: Tanks in front, carries in the back. Damage that is not being hit is damage that keeps happening.
commonMistake: Dropping the carry wherever there is a free hex, often row 1 or 2, because the board feels full.
